\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usepgfplotslibrary{dateplot}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.12}
\newcommand\tickprobe[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{#2}%
  \typeout{TICK-POLICY #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
  \noindent #1: \copy0\par
}
\tracingoutput=1
\showboxbreadth=100
\showboxdepth=100
\begin{document}
\tickprobe{KIT-number}{\scriptsize\pgfmathprintnumber[1000 sep=]{1988}}
\tickprobe{date-T1}{1946}
\tickprobe{date-OT1}{\fontencoding{OT1}\selectfont 1946}
\tickprobe{literal-A}{\fontencoding{OT1}\selectfont A}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[date coordinates in=x,date ZERO=1946-06-30,
  xmin=1946-01-01,xmax=1947-01-01,ymin=0,ymax=2,xtick=data,ytick=\empty,
  xticklabel={\typeout{TICK-POLICY date year=\year}\year},
  x tick label style={align=center,rotate=45}]
  \addplot coordinates {(1946-06-30,1) (1946-12-01,1)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
